# Repository-wide Copilot instructions

- Python: type hints on public functions, FastAPI + pydantic models for
  request bodies, tests in backend/tests for every endpoint change.
- JavaScript: React function components with hooks only. No new dependencies
  without an approved plan.
- Every PR description must state: which issue it implements, which plan file
  it follows, and how the success criteria were verified.
- If a task is ambiguous or lacks success criteria, stop and ask on the issue
  instead of guessing. An escalation comment is a successful outcome.
